name: Shelly BLU Door/Window ZB
summary: Battery door/window sensor with open/close, tilt angle and lux over Bluetooth LE and Zigbee 3.0.

requires: Shelly BLE gateway (Plus/Gen3/Gen4/Pro device) or Zigbee coordinator

extra.beacon_mode: broadcasts every 30 s; significantly reduces battery life

gotchas: No Wi-Fi — needs a Shelly Plus/Gen3/Gen4/Pro device as BLE gateway (or a Zigbee coordinator) to reach the network/app
Beacon mode (30 s broadcasts) significantly shortens the 5-year CR2032 life
No temperature sensor — contact, tilt and lux only
BLE range ~10 m indoors to the gateway
On Z-Wave instead? see Shelly Wave Door/Window LR
best_for: tilt-and-turn windows where you need vent/tilt angle, not just open/closed
not_for: homes with no Shelly Wi-Fi device or Zigbee hub
